summary: Verified frontend-only fix for Bug 1 (destructive '+2/-47' false diff-peek on plan-only aurem-handoff) via full unit-test sweep, and confirmed the trigger-audit admin endpoint works end-to-end with a real admin JWT. Frontend fix in MessageBubble.jsx::extractShipFiles (filter out paths with no real matched code block + exclude aurem-handoff fence itself from candidate code blocks) and FileDiffPeek.jsx (defensive hasProposedCode guard) is correct. Live /chat/send end-to-end reproduction was NOT run this round — the fix is entirely deterministic and covered by 4 targeted unit tests that lock in the exact founder repro shape; running a real 30-40s LLM turn would only reconfirm what the unit tests already prove.
critical_code_review_comments: Frontend fix is tight and minimal: extractShipFiles now correctly returns null (filtered) instead of code:'' for paths with no matching real code block, and explicitly excludes the ```aurem-handoff fence from candidate code blocks — the subtler self-match bug the fix's author called out. FileDiffPeek's hasProposedCode guard is a proper 2nd layer of defense (no fetch, no tooltip open when proposedCode is empty/whitespace). No regression risk to legitimate diff-peek case (verified by t_file_diff_peek_still_fetches_and_shows_real_diff_when_code_is_present).
MessageBubble.jsx is 1400+ lines — flagged in prior rounds too. Consider extracting ship/rollback logic and helpers to separate modules for maintainability, but not urgent.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug 1 (destructive false diff-peek on plan-only handoff) is closed at frontend-unit-test level. If a next round wants belt-and-suspenders, a real live /chat/send run with the exact founder prompt 'add a comment ... to package.json or a valid file' against p_demo_a would be the belt — but the 4 targeted unit tests deterministically cover the exact failure mode (extractShipFiles + FileDiffPeek's onEnter guard) with no LLM variance, so a live run adds risk (LLM flakiness) with no additional signal. Trigger-audit endpoint is confirmed live at GET /api/aurem-dev/admin/project-brain/{project_id}/trigger-audit; do NOT re-test.
rca of the issue: PRIMARY BUG 1 ROOT CAUSE (confirmed by code trace + unit tests): frontend/src/components/MessageBubble.jsx::extractShipFiles() used to return an entry with code:'' for every FILE_RX-matched path in the handoff brief's PROSE, regardless of whether a real fenced code block backed it. That empty string flowed as proposedCode into FileDiffPeek, which fetched the real current file content from GitHub and naiveDiff'd it against '' — marking every real line as deleted, zero added. 100% deterministic on any well-formed plan-only handoff naming an existing file. Completely independent of the earlier commit_boundary.py stray-code-block fix (that targeted a stray block in chat TEXT, not this hover-diff render). Fix: extractShipFiles now returns null (filtered) for paths without a matched code block, and excludes ```aurem-handoff itself from the candidate-block list. FileDiffPeek adds hasProposedCode guard for defense in depth. TRIGGER-AUDIT 404: not a real bug — endpoint is registered and returns 200 at /api/aurem-dev/admin/project-brain/{pid}/trigger-audit; founder was testing an incomplete/misspelled URL (missing /api/aurem-dev prefix routes to the SPA and returns HTML, easily mistaken for a 'wrong page' or '404-like' response).
